title: Simons engineered Stony Brook joint management of Brookhaven National Lab
place_text: Brookhaven National Laboratory, Long Island, New York

tellings.quote: Stony Brook University was um uh engineered essentially a uh a joint venture essentially to manage Brook Haven National Lab with Vattel Memorial Institute. That partnership was personally engineered by Jim Simons himself

plain: The researcher Matthew Pines says that Stony Brook University teamed up with the Battelle Memorial Institute, a private research organisation, to run Brookhaven National Laboratory, a US government research lab on Long Island. He says the partnership was "personally engineered" by Jim Simons, the mathematician and hedge fund founder, and he names no source for it. He raises it to show how much quiet influence Simons had over American science.
